summary: A cow-shaped ghost (pale blue blotches with dark green inside) sits on the canvas from step 1 to step 10, and later steps keep showing work from the step after them (gold in the gray clouds, the gold rim and grass outlines in the rust locks). The cow and horn steps jump: step 13 repaints the face and body far beyond its gold rim, and step 15 darkens the whole horn against its own tip. The words misplace the grass top by 2 in or more in steps 8 and 10 and name dull single paints where the pictures add bright golds and teals.
